p: clouds return after the rain: Before you come to a continual misery: for when the clouds remain after the rain, man's grief is increased.
keepers of the house shall tremble: The hands which keep the body.
strong men shall bow themselves: The legs.
grinders cease because they are few: The teeth.
look out of the windows shall: The eyes.
doors shall be shut in the: The lips or mouth.
grinding shall be low: When the jaws will scarce open and not be able to chew any more.
bird: He will not be able to sleep.
daughters of music shall be brought: That is the wind pipes or the ears will be deaf and not able to hear singing.
high: To climb high because of their weakness, or they stoop down as though they were afraid lest anything should hide them.
way: They will tremble as they go, as though they were afraid.
flourish: Their head will be as white as the blossoms of an almond tree.
grasshopper shall be a burden: They will be able to bear nothing.
silver cord shall be loosed: Meaning, the marrow of the backbone and the sinews.
bowl be broken: The little skin that covers the brain, which is in colour like gold.
pitcher be broken at the: That is, the veins.
fountain: Meaning the liver.
wheel broken at the: Which is the head.
cistern: That is, the heart out of which the head draws the powers of life.
spirit shall return to God who: The soul unconsciously goes either to joy or torment, and sleeps not as the wicked imagine.
fastened by the masters of assemblies: Which are well applied by the ministers, whom he calls masters.
shepherd: That is by God.

books there is no end: These things cannot be comprehended in books or learned by study, but God must instruct your heart that you may only know that wisdom is the true happiness and the way to it is to fear God.
